items.summary: Security forces rescued all the hostages held for nearly a day at a supermarket in the northern Colombian tourist city of Cartagena, President Abelardo de la Espriella said early Wednesday. The hostage situation broke out as Colombia is experiencing a wave of attacks by rebel groups on government targets.
